crossingIdentityCoverage.interpretation: Potential input identity coverage only. This does not count correctly simulated crossings or use future outcomes to accept demand.

quality.source: Historical automatic tracker: ID switches, missed detections, trajectory gaps and projection extrapolation remain unresolved
quality.demandBoundary: Two consecutive inside samples confirm arrivals. Route and velocity use history ending at timeBracket START. Confirmation sample only filters eligibility. No observed future exit is a route label.
quality.inferredOutboundBoundary: Confirmed internal tunnel births use independent deep-cut outbound demand proxy, never their observed internal position as a simulated insertion point
